response.original_title: चिन्ता र चिता | Chinta Ra Chita
response.overview: Chinta Ra Chita (Anxiety and the Funeral Pyre) explores the delicate line between loving someone and being consumed by the fear of losing them. It reflects on the quiet weight of human existence—how love brings responsibility, responsibility breeds constant worry (chinta), and how that worry can destroy life long before death (chita) actually arrives.
response.tagline: Love brings responsibility. Responsibility brings fear.
